description: Forge: token capture, context-pack guards, touched-file tracking. Inert unless a Forge run is active in the project. Picks the first working Python 3.8+ (python3, python, py), so it runs on macOS, Linux and Windows.

hooks.command: sh -c 'for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$0" "$@"; done; exit 0' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" session-start
